log.text: Light Screen up on P1's side
Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Whimsicott
Light Screen ended on P1's side

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: none (bench Swampertite). Lead Grimm+Gyarados: Prankster Reflect/Fake Out + Intimidate blunt Mega Meta/Whims T1. Back Arch+Ghold complete vs specials: LO Stamina Electro/Draco + GaG MIR/SB beat Rotom/Serp/Meta and block status. Avoids G1 rain core blanked by Rotom Levitate.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: opp Cloud Nine Altaria, Prankster Whimsicott (Mental Herb TWave/Taunt/Encore/Moonblast), Mega Meta Jolly MM/ST/BP/Protect (Protect-heavy; BP/ST), Contrary Serperior sash Leaf Storm/Dragon Pulse/Glare/Protect, Rotom-W Modest Sitrus Tbolt/Hydro/Eweb/Protect (Hydro spam; cleaner), Intimidate Arcanine Passho. G1 bring: Whims/Meta/Serp/Rotom (Altaria/Arcanine benched). Rain Mega Swampert+Peli+Arch+Gholdengo blanked by Rotom Levitate—avoid that preview; prefer Grimm screens vs physical Meta or Gyarados Intim; delay/deny Mega Swamp when Rotom+Meta likely; still Ice Punch 4x Altaria. Register: Peli DampRock Drizzle; Swampite Adamant EQ/Liq/IP; Arch LO Stamina EShot/FC/DM/Protect; Ghold LoG GaG MIR/SB/NP/Protect; Grimm LC screens; Gyarados Sitrus Intim DD. G2 plan: Grimm+Gyarados+Arch+Ghold (no rain/Swamp).

decisions.rationale: Use Whimsicott/Rotom-Wash to deny or punish Pelipper rain: Taunt stops Helping Hand while Thunderbolt threatens Pelipper, and Tailwind supports the whole mode. Serperior supplies Leaf Storm pressure into Swampert with Focus Sash insurance. Intended Mega is Metagross, preserved for a late-game Meteor Mash/Stomping Tantrum endgame after rain attackers are constrained.
decisions.notebook: Opponent game-1 mode was Damp Rock Pelipper rain with Mega Swampert, Life Orb Stamina Archaludon, and Leftovers Gholdengo; Grimmsnarl and Gyarados were omitted. Swampert revealed Earthquake, Liquidation, Ice Punch, Protect. Archaludon revealed Electro Shot, Flash Cannon, Draco Meteor, Protect. Gholdengo revealed Make It Rain, Shadow Ball, Nasty Plot, Protect. Rotom-Wash’s Levitate is valuable into Swampert Earthquake. Preserve Mega Metagross for Gholdengo after Swampert is managed.

decisions.rationale: Prankster FO flinches Whims before Tailwind/Taunt/Encore. Gyara Ice Fangs Whims (2x, 35-81%) after FO; Rotom Tbolt OHKOs Gyara so must deny support first. Screens leave Whims free; EQ chips ally and misses OHKO Rotom.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: opp Cloud Nine Altaria, Prankster Whimsicott (Mental Herb Taunt/Encore/Moonblast/Tailwind), Mega Meta Jolly MM/ST/BP/Protect (Protect-heavy), Contrary Serperior sash Leaf Storm/Dragon Pulse/Glare/Protect, Rotom-W Modest Sitrus Tbolt/Hydro/Eweb/Protect (Hydro spam), Intimidate Arcanine Passho. G1 bring: Whims/Meta/Serp/Rotom (Altaria/Arcanine benched). Avoid rain Mega Swampert+Peli vs Rotom Levitate. G2: Grimm+Gyarados+Arch+Ghold. Register: Peli DampRock Drizzle; Swampite Adamant EQ/Liq/IP; Arch LO Stamina EShot/FC/DM/Protect; Ghold LoG GaG MIR/SB/NP/Protect; Grimm LC screens; Gyarados Sitrus Intim DD. Prefer Grimm screens vs physical Meta or Gyarados Intim; delay Mega Swamp when Rotom+Meta.

decisions.rationale: Whims at 14% dies to any hit; GaG Ghold negates Prankster Taunt/Encore/Moonblast pressure and MIR cleans while Arch is slower and status-weak. Arch walls Rotom better later.

Prefer Grimm screens vs physical Meta or Gyarados Intim; delay Mega Swamp when Rotom+Meta. Ghold GaG key vs Whims status.

decisions.rationale: Taunt moves before opposing Prankster screens and denies Grimmsnarl’s long-term support. Thunderbolt is a guaranteed OHKO on Gyarados if Rotom-Wash is not flinched. If Fake Out targets Rotom-Wash, Taunt still prevents screens and leaves Tailwind available next turn to answer Dragon Dance.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Gholdengo)
decisions.rationale: Whims at 14%: MIR OHKOs through spread (88%+ min) and GaG blocks status. Prankster LS first softens Rotom Hydro/Tbolt and Meta later. Spirit Break fails KO; Shadow Ball fails KO. Protect cedes free turn. Screens > switch Arch.

Prefer Grimm screens vs physical Meta or Gyarados Intim; delay Mega Swamp when Rotom+Meta. Ghold GaG key vs Whims status. Whims MentalHerb spent G2 T1 FakeOut.

decisions.rationale: Prankster Tailwind is guaranteed before Grimmsnarl’s screens and lets Rotom outrun every revealed Gholdengo Speed. Hydro Pump is a guaranteed OHKO on Gholdengo if it attacks; if it Protects, Tailwind still creates the strongest follow-up for Rotom and the back line. Rotom heavily resists Make It Rain.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s game-1 rain mode: Damp Rock Pelipper, Mega Swampert, Life Orb Stamina Archaludon, Leftovers Gholdengo. Swampert has Earthquake/Liquidation/Ice Punch/Protect; Rotom-Wash Levitate is valuable into Earthquake. Preserve Mega Metagross as a Gholdengo answer after Swampert is managed. Game 2 Grimmsnarl revealed Fake Out, with Reflect/Light Screen/Spirit Break on sheet; Gyarados was KOed by Rotom Thunderbolt.

decisions.rationale: Bring Metagross: it is the planned Gholdengo answer and Tailwind lets it apply immediate pressure. Serperior is more valuable later versus the rain backline, while Metagross can force Gholdengo to Protect or risk Stomping Tantrum.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s game-1 rain mode: Damp Rock Pelipper, Mega Swampert, Life Orb Stamina Archaludon, Leftovers Gholdengo. Swampert has Earthquake/Liquidation/Ice Punch/Protect; Rotom-Wash Levitate is valuable into Earthquake. Preserve Serperior where possible for the rain backline. Game 2 Grimmsnarl revealed Fake Out, Reflect, Light Screen, and Spirit Break; Gyarados was KOed by Rotom Thunderbolt.

decisions.rationale: LS up; TW lets both foes move first. Meta physical threatens OHKO (MM Grimm; ST Ghold from 63%). Prankster Reflect first halves physical; Ghold Protect blocks ST/Hydro. Survive BP through Reflect; accept MM KO Grimm if needed. SB Meta unreliable at -2 SpA after they act.

Meta entered G2 after Whims KO; expect Mega + physical pressure under TW.

decisions.rationale: Force damage through their key special and physical attackers: even if Grimmsnarl puts up Reflect, the combined Ground and Water pressure should remove Gholdengo if it does not Protect. Mega Evolution also maximizes the immediate Stomping Tantrum damage while Tailwind guarantees Metagross moves before Gholdengo.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Ghold -2 SpA; Reflect/LS up. Meta TW-fast; ST KOs Ghold through Reflect often, Hydro through LS often. Protect (50%) is best Ghold survival vs dual target; Spirit Break Rotom chips/drops SpA while Grimm likely lives BP under Reflect. Avoid free SE into Ghold.

Double Gholdengo through both screens: Reflect makes Tantrum alone unreliable and Light Screen makes Hydro Pump alone unreliable, but together remove the dangerous Steel/Ghost attacker if it does not land its reduced-success consecutive Protect. Metagross moves before Gholdengo under Tailwind. Preserve Serperior for the likely rain backline.

Gholdengo is -2 SpA so attacks are halved; Protect streak is poor. Screens let it live Meta ST + Rotom Hydro; Nasty Plot resets to 0 as TW ends. Grimm keeps SpA-dropping Rotom (already -1) instead of weak Fairy into Meta.

Meta entered G2 after Whims KO; Mega + physical pressure under TW. Rotom takes repeated Spirit Break SpA drops.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Stomping Tantrum cleanly threatens Gholdengo before it can Shadow Ball, and its third consecutive Protect is heavily unreliable. Rotom Protect denies Spirit Break and preserves Electric/Water utility for the rain backline. If Gholdengo pivots, Serperior remains intact to punish Swampert.

Screens up; no rain so Electro Shot charges. Meta outspeeds and ST threatens Arch. Protect Arch denies free SE hit; SB Rotom further drops SpA or chips if no Protect (decay odds). Preserve Arch as wincon vs backline.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: opp Cloud Nine Altaria, Prankster Whimsicott (Mental Herb Taunt/Encore/Moonblast/Tailwind), Mega Meta Jolly MM/ST/BP/Protect (Protect-heavy), Contrary Serperior sash Leaf Storm/Dragon Pulse/Glare/Protect, Rotom-W Modest Sitrus Tbolt/Hydro/Eweb/Protect (Hydro spam), Intimidate Arcanine Passho. G1 bring: Whims/Meta/Serp/Rotom. G2 bring Grimm+Gyarados+Arch+Ghold. Register: Arch LO Stamina EShot/FC/DM/Protect; Ghold GaG MIR/SB/NP/Protect; Grimm LC screens; Gyarados Sitrus Intim DD. Prefer Grimm screens vs physical Meta; Ghold GaG vs Whims. Whims MentalHerb spent G2 T1. Meta physical under TW. Rotom takes repeated Spirit Break SpA drops. Arch key special vs Serp/Altaria after Meta/Rotom.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Metagross is guaranteed faster than Archaludon and Stomping Tantrum is the only meaningful immediate pressure into it through Reflect. Rotom’s reduced Protect is still preferable to exposing it at low HP to Draco Meteor plus Grimmsnarl pressure; if it fails, Serperior enters safely afterward with Focus Sash and Glare available.

Screens already up. EShot charges (no rain). FC can't KO Rotom; DM does from 43%. Diversify: Grimm chips Meta while Arch deletes Rotom unless Protect (reduced after T6). Reflect halves Meta physical; Rotom -2 SpA under LS is weak.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: opp Cloud Nine Altaria, Prankster Whimsicott (Mental Herb Taunt/Encore/Moonblast/Tailwind), Mega Meta Jolly MM/ST/BP/Protect (Protect-heavy), Contrary Serperior sash Leaf Storm/Dragon Pulse/Glare/Protect, Rotom-W Modest Sitrus Tbolt/Hydro/Eweb/Protect (Hydro spam), Intimidate Arcanine Passho. Prefer Grimm screens vs physical Meta; Ghold GaG vs Whims. Whims MentalHerb spent G2 T1. Meta physical under TW. Rotom takes repeated Spirit Break SpA drops. Arch key special vs Serp/Altaria after Meta/Rotom. Meta Protect-heavy; Rotom Protect-heavy after chip.

decisions.rationale: Remove Grimmsnarl first: Meteor Mash is super-effective and Metagross acts before both foes at normal priority. Switching preserves Rotom from another Spirit Break and introduces Serperior with its Focus Sash intact. Stomping Tantrum into Archaludon is undermined by Reflect and Stamina, while Grimmsnarl is maintaining both screens.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s game-1 rain mode: Damp Rock Pelipper, Mega Swampert, Life Orb Stamina Archaludon, Leftovers Gholdengo. Swampert has Earthquake/Liquidation/Ice Punch/Protect; Rotom-Wash Levitate is valuable into Earthquake. Preserve Serperior where possible for the rain backline. Game 2 Grimmsnarl revealed Fake Out, Reflect, Light Screen, and Spirit Break; Gyarados was KOed by Rotom Thunderbolt. Archaludon has Electro Shot, Flash Cannon, Draco Meteor, Protect, Life Orb, and Stamina; account for Stamina when using physical attacks.

decisions.rationale: Grimm 2% dies to any Meta hit; SB Meta for chip/SpA drop before faint. Arch -2 SpA FlashCannon KOs 1% Serp (Steel 1x) through LO; Protect risks free turn. Screens already up.

Bullet Punch safely removes the 2% Grimmsnarl through its remaining Reflect before it can meaningfully interfere. Protect preserves 1% Serperior from Archaludon’s likely Steel attack, leaving Metagross and Serperior against Archaludon next turn; Metagross can then pressure it with super-effective Stomping Tantrum.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s game-1 rain mode: Damp Rock Pelipper, Mega Swampert, Life Orb Stamina Archaludon, Leftovers Gholdengo. Swampert has Earthquake/Liquidation/Ice Punch/Protect; Rotom-Wash Levitate is valuable into Earthquake. Preserve Serperior where possible for rain backline. Game 2 Grimmsnarl revealed Fake Out, Reflect, Light Screen, and Spirit Break; Gyarados was KOed by Rotom Thunderbolt. Archaludon has Electro Shot, Flash Cannon, Draco Meteor, Protect, Life Orb, and Stamina; account for Stamina when using physical attacks.

decisions.rationale: Serp 1% sash gone; FC KOes through -2 unless Protect (reduced odds). Screens up; Meta ST 2x but Reflect. KO Serp now forces Rotom or lose board. Protect lets free setup/turn. FC>DM accuracy.

Serperior cannot safely remain at 1% and its consecutive Protect is unreliable. Switching preserves it while Metagross pressures Archaludon; if Archaludon Protects, Reflect expires and Rotom joins the endgame. Flash Cannon is resisted by incoming Rotom, whereas Stomping Tantrum is the only listed super-effective pressure.
Only Arch left at 40%. Meta outspeeds and ST KOs through +1 Def/Reflect; Protect is mandatory to live the turn, burn Reflect, and force their play. Attacking into 20% Rotom or Meta risks free KO.

Stomping Tantrum moves before Archaludon and chunks it through its final Reflect turn; Thunderbolt is the accurate cleanup and avoids Hydro Pump’s miss risk. Archaludon is at -2 SpA, while Flash Cannon is heavily resisted by Rotom, so Rotom should get its attack unless Archaludon Protects.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Arch 40% dies to Meta ST; Protect is only play despite reduced odds. SpA-2 weakens offense; KO Rotom next if Protect hits.

Metagross is faster and Stomping Tantrum is a guaranteed KO on Archaludon if it does not Protect. Rotom Protect covers the only relevant Protect-success branch while preserving it from a possible attack; if Archaludon attacks, it faints before moving.

Protect streak 2 heavily reduced; must attack. Rotom 20% dies to any hit (even resisted FC/DM after LO). KO Rotom with DM removes Protect option and Hydro threat; Meta ST still hurts but Arch lives longer 1v1 with Def+1 vs physical. SpA-2 makes Meta chip weak.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Metagross is guaranteed faster and Stomping Tantrum safely chips Archaludon through its Defense boost. Protect preserves the low Rotom from Draco Meteor; even if repeated Protect fails, Metagross can finish the weakened Archaludon before it moves next turn. A third Protect is heavily unreliable and only delays the endgame.

reflections.summary: Lost because the Grimm+Gyarados+Arch+Ghold preview (screens/Intimidate into physical Meta, Arch as late special) failed to suit the Protect-heavy Meta+Rotom core; once support died, Arch was outlasted by repeated Stomping Tantrum with no remaining breakers.
reflections.adjustment: Question and change the preview four itself next time—do not re-bring this screens+Arch late-game package; select a set that applies immediate pressure to Mega Metagross instead of relying on stalling into it.
reflections.notebook: Matchup: opp Cloud Nine Altaria, Prankster Whimsicott (Mental Herb Taunt/Encore/Moonblast/Tailwind), Mega Meta Jolly MM/ST/BP/Protect (Protect-heavy, heavy ST spam), Contrary Serperior sash Leaf Storm/Dragon Pulse/Glare/Protect, Rotom-W Modest Sitrus Tbolt/Hydro/Eweb/Protect (Protect-heavy, Hydro/Tbolt), Intimidate Arcanine Passho. Consistent bring both games: Whims/Meta/Serp/Rotom. Whims MentalHerb spent G2. Meta physical under TW. Rotom takes Spirit Break SpA drops. Arch LO Stamina; Ghold GaG; Grimm LC screens; Gyarados Sitrus Intim DD. Screens+Arch late plan insufficient vs this Meta/Rotom; need preview that pressures Meta earlier.

reflections.summary: Won because the Mega Metagross/Rotom-Wash four matched the opponent’s non-rain screens/Steel mode well: Grimmsnarl was removed, Rotom covered Gyarados, and Metagross’s Ground coverage eventually finished Archaludon. Mega Metagross was the correct intended Mega and the brought four suited this version of the opponent’s team.
reflections.adjustment: Against this screens/Steel mode, bring Mega Metagross and Rotom-Wash again, but prioritize denying or removing Grimmsnarl early and avoid committing both attacks into Archaludon when it can repeatedly Protect.
reflections.notebook: Opponent can shift from Pelipper-Swampert rain into a Grimmsnarl screens plus Gyarados/Archaludon/Gholdengo mode. Grimmsnarl has Fake Out, Reflect, Light Screen, and Spirit Break with Light Clay. Gyarados has Intimidate, Waterfall, Earthquake, Ice Fang, and Dragon Dance. Archaludon is Life Orb Stamina with Electro Shot, Flash Cannon, Draco Meteor, and Protect; physical hits raise its Defense. Mega Metagross plus Rotom-Wash is a strong planned core into the non-rain mode; preserve Rotom-Wash for Gyarados and Earthquake immunity, and remove Grimmsnarl promptly.
